title: Container Playground
summary: Run the same small HTTP application in Python, Docker or an isolated Azure container; change versions and reproduce a startup failure.
objectives: Run the same small HTTP application in Python, Docker or an isolated Azure container; change versions and reproduce a startup failure.
Try the healthy path, reproduce a controlled failure and verify recovery.
Collect sanitized evidence and remove only the selected deployment.

sandbox_notes: Implemented with offline checks; no live Pluralsight deployment has been verified.
Use only the assigned resource group; one project per session.
Local adapters/simulations do not validate Azure permissions, timing, networking or quotas.
production_extensions: Use least-privilege identities, durable protected state, release controls and service-appropriate private access.
